title: Suspension of Ochre Jelly
summary: Alchemical extract used for Elixir of Guileful Movement.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Ochre Jelly Slimes to make one Suspension of Ochre Jelly.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Sublimate to make Elixir of Guileful Movement.
